human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Extend the existing evidence-package validator to enforce runtime-evidence-v1 identity, source/run consistency, event uniqueness/order rules, provenance path safety, and count/digest consistency while preserving older accepted package behavior. Dependency: 8005.harden-evidence-package-model.
human_pressure.why_now: Ailuros must reject corrupted handoff data before any projection or dashboard computation.
do_not_misread: This pack is intentionally narrow; do not absorb later packs into it.
Evidence is authoritative; derived state must remain reconstructable from evidence.
red_lines: Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.

machine_core.goal: Implement deterministic contract validation for runtime evidence package v1.
red_lines: Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
invariants: Depends on: 8005.harden-evidence-package-model. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
Invalid package never enters normal projection path.
contracts: Contract validator implements runtime-evidence-package-v1 docs only.
failure_semantics: Invalid contract returns explicit errors; warnings never silently promote invalid data to valid.

steps.title: Detect v1 contract by schema
details: Apply new checks only to the new schema version.
Keep old v1.5 fixtures on their existing validation path.

steps.title: Validate provenance safety
details: Artifact/source pointers are package-relative logical refs, not filesystem traversal.
Reject ../ and absolute local paths where contract forbids them.

steps.title: Validate counts/digest declarations
details: Manifest counts match loaded events/artifacts when declared.

acceptance: Run-id mismatch, duplicate event ID, unsafe path, malformed count fail.
Older evidence package validator tests remain green.
Validator does not derive governance outcome.

reject_if: Validator treats source runtime outcome as Ailuros policy decision.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Existing validator tests plus new runtime-evidence-v1 contract tests.
